sections.template: Fill after obtaining the declared observations.

stages.instruction: Before subject work agree coarse Task phases with the independent reviewer. Define scope/constraints and design only imminent read-only baseline capture: goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact authorized target/current identity, readiness, methods, completeness, limits and preservation. Do not prescribe detailed changes before actual baseline acceptance or mutate state during design.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact actual identities, methods/evidence receipts, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.
sections.scope: Identify included/excluded subjects, actual authorized targets and desired state, permitted deliverable paths, object/action authority and limits. Generic Task selection or path access never authorizes an irreversible/destructive effect.
sections.constraints: For each constraint state ID, predicate, source, scope and verification method. Explicitly justify none. Preserve existing data and actual configured runtime identities.
sections.baseline_verification_plan: For imminent baseline only, bind requirement/DoD references to exact existing PlannedInvocation HR-054 or declared logical/inspection methods, before/after predicates, phase applicability, reuse/retry/limits. Runtime supplies actual BoundExecution digests; never invent future commands/hashes.
sections.baseline_plan: State imminent baseline goal, required result, acceptance criteria, exact target/runtime/source/config/data identity and read-only readiness/state/capture methods, completeness, resource limits and preservation.

stages.instruction: Independently review imminent baseline design for executability, completeness and unambiguity: scope, actual target/object/action authority, constraints, goals/results/acceptance, exact read-only methods, capture, limits and preservation. Reject design to framing.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact actual identities, methods/evidence receipts, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.

stages.instruction: Execute only accepted baseline capture through exact declared read-only methods. Publish actual baseline_evidence with current target/runtime/source/config/data identities, stage/check receipts, readiness and completeness. Preserve databases/rows and originals; do not apply changes or fabricate missing observations.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact actual identities, methods/evidence receipts, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.
sections.baseline_evidence: Publish actual baseline stage/check receipts, target/runtime/source/config/data identities, observed prechange state/readiness, limits and completeness. Missing required observation is not a complete baseline; preserve existing rows and originals.

stages.instruction: Independently verify actual baseline_evidence and exact receipts against accepted baseline design, target identity/readiness, coverage, constraints and preservation. Incomplete capture cannot pass. Reject execution to baseline; accept actual baseline before change planning.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact actual identities, methods/evidence receipts, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.

stages.instruction: Only after actual baseline acceptance, design imminent application and proof: goal, required desired-state/no-regression result, acceptance criteria, exact authorized actions and prerequisites, state-aware replay, limits, safe interruption, required backup capture/restore checks and rollback triggers. Distinguish failed desired-state predicates from incomplete capture. Define actual mutable rollback ownership and refusal of unsafe/unknown-state replay. Do not apply changes or infer destructive authority from Task selection.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact actual identities, methods/evidence receipts, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.
sections.change_plan: State current change goal, required desired-state/no-regression result, acceptance criteria, exact ordered authorized actions, accepted baseline identity, prerequisites, privileges, observable receipts and bounds. Every attempt must recheck actual current/prechange identity and replay preconditions; never blindly reapply. Specify safe interruption, partial effects, rollback triggers and unsafe/unknown-state refusal.
sections.rollback_plan: Specify actual reversible steps, exact undo and restoration probes, prechange/backup identities and capture/restore verification, rollback triggers and interruption handling. Identify irreversible/destructive effects and their actual object/action user authority. Restoration alone is not proof of the recovery goal. Keep temporary backups only while active recovery/rollback needs them; after acceptance remove exact owned copies through their owner, never unrelated originals or a permanent working archive.
sections.verification_plan: For the imminent change bind desired-state/no-regression obligations to exact existing PlannedInvocation HR-054 or declared logical/inspection methods, current target/runtime/source/config/data identity, predicates, retries and bounds. Distinguish a failed predicate from incomplete capture. Require latest complete satisfied proof and actual verification.verdict for the current identity; actual BoundExecution/receipts come from execution.

stages.instruction: Independently review current change/rollback/verification plans against accepted actual baseline for executability, completeness and unambiguity. Check desired-state/no-regression criteria, exact authorized actions, current-identity/replay guards, partial effects, actual backup/restoration proof, interruption/rollback triggers, resource limits and eventual temporary-copy cleanup. Decide only application execution criteria. Reject design to change_planning; do not modify accepted baseline.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact actual identities, methods/evidence receipts, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.

stages.instruction: Execute only accepted exact actions within config/** and scripts/** and the actual object/action authority. At every attempt first verify actual current/prechange identity, readiness and replay preconditions; re-entry is never blind reapplication. Capture receipts/partial effects. Execute agreed rollback through this authorized mutable owner under its actual triggers and verify actual restoration. Refuse unsafe/unknown-state replay instead of guessing. Preserve original data; generic paths never authorize destructive effects. An invalid accepted plan requires the actual owner/lifecycle, not automatic redesign. Keep required temporary backups while active recovery/rollback needs them; remove only exact owned copies after acceptance removes that need, through their owner. Restoration of old baseline is not achievement of the recovery goal.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact actual identities, methods/evidence receipts, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.

stages.instruction: Run only accepted exact read-only desired-state/no-regression checks for current target/runtime/source/config/data identity. Publish actual declared verification.verdict and complete current receipts; a placeholder, stale success or successful rollback is not recovery proof. Distinguish failed predicates from incomplete capture. Only satisfied proceeds to independent inspection; not_satisfied/inconclusive return to application with its state/replay guards and accepted rollback policy. Do not mutate state or invent waivers.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact actual identities, methods/evidence receipts, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.

stages.instruction: Independently verify actual current recovered state, full diff/action receipts, accepted change/rollback/verification plans, constraints and preservation, development rules and general result requirements. Require latest complete satisfied desired-state/no-regression proof and actual verification.verdict for current identity. Successful rollback alone cannot pass recovery. Check actual backup/restore provenance and owned temporary-copy disposition without deleting unrelated originals. Reject execution to application in this same phase, never automatically to accepted design. Do not edit product/state or fabricate user acceptance/waivers.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact actual identities, methods/evidence receipts, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.
sections.result: Record actual final substantive recovery result, current target identity, complete desired-state/no-regression proof, fulfilled/unfulfilled DoD/verdicts, deliverables, rollback/restore and backup disposition, incidents, limitations and remaining delivery obligations. Do not equate restored old baseline with achieved recovery or fabricate acceptance/waivers.
